lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's twelve? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 12? Nope!

lines.text: A frog hops around a hexagon, to either neighbor, with chance one half.
lines.caption: A frog hops around a hexagon, to either neighbor, with chance 1/2.

lines.text: On average, how many jumps to visit all six corners?
lines.caption: On average, how many jumps to visit all 6 corners?

lines.text: Color the visited corners green: always one block, with the frog at an end.
lines.caption: Color the visited corners green: always one block, with the frog at an end.

lines.text: Straighten it, with an exit on each side. The average wait is steps to one exit, times steps to the other.
lines.caption: Straighten it, with an exit on each side. The average wait is steps to one exit, times steps to the other.

lines.text: So, one times four: four jumps! The stages go one, two, three, four, five!
lines.caption: So, 1 × 4: 4 jumps! The stages go 1, 2, 3, 4, 5!

lines.text: Add them up, and you get fifteen jumps!
lines.caption: Add them up, and you get 15 jumps!

lines.text: Twelve was the trap. The stages aren't equal!
lines.caption: 12 was the trap. The stages aren't equal!

lines.text: Did you get fifteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 15? Tell me below!
